mandatoryQualityRules: Every one of the 791 source texts must receive a manually reviewed native-level Ukrainian equivalent.
Ukrainian wording must not be copied mechanically from Russian; false friends, calques and mixed-language residue are forbidden.
User-entered names, notes, labels and free text must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Plural, case, gender and dynamic sentence structures must be implemented explicitly rather than assembled from unsafe fragments.
Ukraine date, number, currency and search behavior must be verified independently from Russian behavior.
No Ukrainian runtime activation is allowed before language purity, full regression, visual, storage, CSV, report, PDF, notification and release gates pass.
All previously integrated languages must remain isolated and unchanged outside intentional shared-runtime corrections.
